item.title: BACK HOME: Remains of WWII Navigator identified and returned to Beaumont
item.description: 81 years after his plane was shot down over Austria, a WWII Airman was identified and laid to rest next to his parents in Beaumont.

item.title: 'Zootopia 2' star Yvette Nicole Brown reveals she wants these characters to end up together
item.description: Clear your sssschedule! "Zootopia 2" is coming to Disney+! Plus, Yvette Nicole Brown reveals the characters she ships together!

item.title: FIRST LOOK: Gaten Matarazzo's first project since 'Stranger Things' to premiere on Hulu
item.description: FIRST LOOK: Gaten Matarazzo stars in Hulu's "Pizza Movie," his first project since the conclusion of "Stranger Things."

item.title: Texas judge declines to close Camp Mystic despite family's request after last year's floods
item.description: Judge Maya Guerra Gamble did order Camp Mystic's owners not to alter or demolish the cabins where campers were housed during the floods.

item.title: 'Hoppers,' Disney-Pixar's latest animated adventure, features beavers as animal superheroes
item.description: Beavers are the superstars of "Hoppers." The filmmakers regard them as the animal superheroes of the environment. They worked with scientists to learn all about beavers as they created a story about the importance of community.

item.title: SE Texas judge primaries: Winner in Montgomery Co., shake-up in Fort Bend Co., runoff in Harris Co.
item.description: According to unofficial election results, Mark Keough narrowly won the Republican primary for Montgomery County Judge. In Harris and Fort Bend Counties, some runoffs are still ahead.

item.title: 2026 Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Parade rolls through downtown, celebrating Western heritage
item.description: The 2026 Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Parade marked the official start of rodeo season, with people gathering in downtown to celebrate Western heritage and culture.

item.title: Unlicensed dentist saw patients at Sharpstown apartment, police say
item.description: A man who police say isn't licensed to practice dentistry is accused of seeing patients at his Sharpstown apartment.

item.title: Houston's weather pattern turns stormier this weekend and for part of Spring Break
item.description: We'll be monitoring the sky for spring-like thunderstorms over the next week.

item.title: Judge rules companies entitled to refunds for Trump tariffs overturned by SCOTUS
item.description: In a defeat for the Trump administration, a federal judge in New York ruled Wednesday that companies that paid tariffs struck down last month by Supreme Court are due refunds.
